description: Destructive guard (opt-in): denies or asks before destructive Bash commands such as recursive rm of root paths, git discards, SQL drops, and infra teardown. Agent git guard: limits the worker and reviewer subagents to read-only git and keeps them out of .git and git config files. Comment lint: flags wrapped, overlong, banner, and multi-line block comments added by Edit/Write. Test guard: lists test cases added by Edit/Write to a test file and asks the agent to delete the ones that catch no plausible regression. Arc reload: re-injects the arc rules after compaction when /arc-kit:arc ran this session

hooks.command: set -f; set -- $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_DESTRUCTIVE_GUARD_ENABLED; case "$*" in [Tt][Rr][Uu][Ee]|1|[Yy][Ee][Ss]|[Oo][Nn]) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/destructive-guard.py";; esac

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"arc-kit:worker"'*|*'"arc-kit:reviewer"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/agent-git-guard.py" || { echo 'agent-git-guard: the guard could not run, so this command is denied' >&2; exit 2; };; esac

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"arc-kit:worker"'*|*'"arc-kit:reviewer"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/agent-git-guard.py" || { echo 'agent-git-guard: the guard could not run, so this command is denied' >&2; exit 2; };; esac
